vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
降低目标护甲
降低目标的攻击力
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
攻击伤害波及周围单位
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
自身有概率使敌方攻击落空
目标低于生命阈值时直接杀死
飞行移动，能越过地形
提供目标或区域的视野
制造自身或他人的幻象
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
主动使已飞来的弹道落空；“无法被躲避”的说明不算
死亡后复活，或影响复活
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
降低移动速度或攻击速度
降低自身受到的减速效果（如散夜对剑+30%）
缩短自身受到的控制与减益的持续时间（如散夜对剑+16%）
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
召唤有血量的单位（可控或不可控都算），以及夺取已有单位的控制权；按受攻击次数计算的单位和死亡守卫不算
能摧毁树木
可看见隐身单位

objects.subject: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
objects.description_zh: 风暴之灵变成不稳定的电流在战场上横冲直撞，直到他的魔法耗尽或到达目标才停下。施法消耗为%ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%%，每移动100距离消耗%ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%%，本技能造成的伤害每飞行100距离就会递增。
objects.description_en: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
notes_zh: 行进过程中可以使用技能和物品。
该技能可以摧毁树木。
风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。

objects.subject: storm_spirit_galvanized
objects.description_zh: 风暴之灵每次击杀都会获得一点提供%mp_per_kill%点/秒魔法恢复的能量，每%level_divisor%级也会获得一点能量。每次阵亡会损失%charges_per_death%点能量。另外每次获得一点能量时他还会永久获得%perma_mp_per_kill%点/秒魔法恢复。
objects.description_en: Storm Spirit gains a charge of %mp_per_kill% mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every %level_divisor% levels. Loses %charges_per_death% charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains %perma_mp_per_kill% Mana Regen permanently.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法通过击杀获得新的叠加效果。

objects.subject: sven_storm_bolt
objects.description_zh: 斯温用他充满魔力的手套对目标周围内所有敌人造成伤害和眩晕。
objects.description_en: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.

scepter.zh: 提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成%scepter_bonus_damage%点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。
scepter.en: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

objects.subject: sven_great_cleave
objects.description_zh: 斯温以巨力攻击，并对所有附近的敌方单位造成分裂攻击伤害。
objects.description_en: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.

objects.subject: sven_warcry
objects.description_zh: 斯温的战吼激励着同伴作战，提升他们的护甲和移动速度。持续%duration%秒。
objects.description_en: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts %duration% seconds.

shard.zh: 提升作用范围和移动速度加成。现在战吼不可驱散，并提供%base_barrier_amount%点物理伤害护盾。
shard.en: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.

objects.subject: sven_gods_strength
objects.description_zh: 斯温爆发出他流浪剑客的力量，获得攻击力加成和减速抗性，持续%abilityduration%秒。
objects.description_en: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 额外攻击力是基于斯温的基础攻击力和主属性数值。

objects.subject: tiny_avalanche
objects.description_zh: 用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并眩晕。
objects.description_en: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.

objects.subject: tiny_toss
objects.description_zh: 抓起小小身旁%grab_radius%范围内最近的单位，不论敌友，扔向目标单位或神符，落地时将造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
notes_zh: 你可以投掷队友，但他们不会受到伤害。
投掷对建筑物造成33%的伤害。
可以对减益免疫单位施放，但是不能将他们扔起，或对他们造成伤害。
飞行时间是%duration%秒。

objects.subject: tiny_tree_grab
objects.description_zh: 抓起一棵树，使小小在有限次数的攻击里获得攻击距离加成、攻击力加成和溅射攻击。可以将树木扔出，对远距离的敌人造成攻击伤害。
objects.description_en: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
notes_zh: 树木扔出后技能进入冷却。

objects.subject: tiny_tree_channel
objects.description_zh: 持续施法 - 小小进行持续施法，随机将自身周围的树木扔向目标范围。每棵树对该区域内敌人造成的伤害为小小的攻击伤害加上扔树的额外伤害。
objects.description_en: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.

objects.subject: tiny_insurmountable
objects.description_zh: 小小从力量中获得状态和减速抗性。减速抗性还会降低攻击速度减少的影响。
objects.description_en: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes_zh: 不可逾越不会减少长大的攻击速度降低效果。

objects.subject: tiny_grow
objects.description_zh: 小小崎岖的身体不断成长，提升了攻击力、移动速度、护甲和投掷的威力，但攻击速度降低。
objects.description_en: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.

shard.zh: 现在投掷扔出的单位，扔树和树木连掷扔出的树木都会在落地点的更大范围内造成额外伤害和减速效果。
shard.en: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

objects.subject: tiny_toss_tree
objects.description_zh: 将树木扔向目标单位，触发自身对其的攻击，并且对周围目标造成溅射伤害。
objects.description_en: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.

objects.subject: vengefulspirit_magic_missile
objects.description_zh: 向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，眩晕并造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.

shard.zh: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的%bounce_range_pct%%%魔法箭施法距离内。
shard.en: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.

objects.subject: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror
objects.description_zh: 复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。
objects.description_en: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.

objects.subject: vengefulspirit_command_aura
objects.description_zh: 复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得%self_multiplier%%%额外加成。
objects.description_en: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力光环失效。

scepter.zh: 提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。
scepter.en: Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

objects.subject: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
objects.description_zh: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的护盾。
objects.description_en: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

objects.subject: windrunner_shackleshot
objects.description_zh: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则眩晕时间减少至%fail_stun_duration%秒。
objects.description_en: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
notes_zh: 该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多%shackle_distance%距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。

objects.subject: windrunner_powershot
objects.description_zh: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力%abilitychanneltime%秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
objects.description_en: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
notes_zh: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

objects.subject: windrunner_windrun
objects.description_zh: 提升移动速度，并闪避一切物理攻击。
objects.description_en: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

objects.subject: windrunner_focusfire
objects.description_zh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加%bonus_attack_speed%，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
objects.description_en: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
notes_zh: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。

objects.subject: zuus_arc_lightning
objects.description_zh: 释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

objects.subject: zuus_lightning_bolt
objects.description_zh: 召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂眩晕。施放后，雷击在目标周围%sight_radius_night%范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于%spread_aoe%范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
objects.description_en: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
notes_zh: 该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。

objects.subject: zuus_heavenly_jump
objects.description_zh: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近%vision_radius%范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。
objects.description_en: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

objects.subject: zuus_cloud
objects.description_zh: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。
objects.description_en: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得%cloud_bounty_tooltip%金。
以宙斯当前等级的雷击作用于最近的敌方单位。
防御塔和非英雄单位对雷云造成半额伤害。
